title: Loyalty Transformation Accelerates Member Growth for a Leading Global Footwear Retailer
summary: Discover how Concentrix helped a leading footwear retailer boost loyalty revenue by 40% and acquire 250K members in one month.
body_markdown:
As customer expectations shifted toward personalized, omnichannel experiences, the retailer recognized an opportunity to transform its loyalty program into a more strategic driver of customer engagement and growth. Existing experiences needed greater flexibility, improved usability, and stronger integration across digital and physical touchpoints to deliver a more seamless member journey.


The retailer sought to modernize its loyalty ecosystem and mobile experience, making it easier for customers to enroll, engage with rewards, and interact with the brand across channels. At the same time, it needed a scalable foundation to support future growth, innovation, and evolving customer needs.
